title: My twin-stick roguelite Devil's Dungeon has a free browser beta, would love your feedback
author: Lazy_Assistance_1137
selftext:
Devil's Dungeon is a twin-stick roguelite, currently in beta. The browser version is just for the beta. The full game is coming to Steam later. 

You can play it for free here: [https://abissele.itch.io/devils-dungeon](https://abissele.itch.io/devils-dungeon)

How it was made: Claude Opus 5.5 wrote nearly all of the code. The rooms started out as ChatGPT images. Opus then looked at each one, figured out what was new and where everything was placed, and handed a brief to Codex, which created the assets and painted them with Imagen. Characters and animations come from PixelLab, and the voices from ElevenLabs' new v4 model.

Any feedback is welcome: what works, what doesn't, and anything that breaks.

comments.author: Feline_Fan
comments.body: It's a fun game, I like the theme and style.  How much does it cost in tokens to generate something like your game?  I don't use AI but I'm trying to get a feel for the cost and workflow.
